How to Install and Run Ps2 Games in Android

First off, here's a link to an emulator that isn't a direct link to a random APK from someone's Google Docs account.

Second, I would wager 90% of phones out there will run this like absolute shit.

My emulator box struggles to do some ps2 games and it's got an i5 and an 8600GT in it. There's not a lot of phone out there with enough graphics power to do this.

That said, I'll give it a test on my Note 3 and see how it does.

UPDATE: Just tried out 3 different PS2 games (Dragonball 3, Crash 2, God of War 2), all of them ran like dog shit. 30FPS on the opening logos and then immediately crashing to 2-4 fps once the game screen start coming up. You'd need a bleeding edge phone to be able to play anything comfortably. This will be useless for 90% of the Android market. Somebody with a newer phone like an S7 should test it out.
